content.text:
default: &default
  adapter: postgresql
  encoding: unicode
  host: localhost
  pool: 5
  username:
  password:

development: &development
  <<: *default
  database: consul_development

# The staging, preproduction and production dbs are only needed
# for running rake assets:precompile locally before deploying
staging:
  <<: *development

preproduction:
  <<: *development

production:
  <<: *default
  database: consul_production

test:
  <<: *default
  database: consul_test

observation.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
c = open('config/database.yml').read()
# restore preproduction to inherit from development (as in example)
c = c.replace("preproduction:
  <<: *default
  database: consul_production
",
              "preproduction:
  <<: *development
", 1)
# point production at consul_production
c = c.replace("
production:
  <<: *development
", "
production:
  <<: *default
  database: consul_production
", 1)
open('config/database.yml','w').write(c)
EOF
cat config/database.yml
